changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwvaccinebrands AS SELECT vb.id, vb.vaccine_id, vb.name, vb.manufacture, vb.volume, vb.unit, vb.marketing_authorization_holder, vb.is_active, vb.created_by, vb.created_date, vb.last_modified_by, vb.last_modified_date FROM public.vaccine_brands vb;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwvaccinebrands TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwvaccinebrands FROM report_user;
